name: Hikagemono ~Ryoujoku no Torikago~
source:
Main character works as a technician at "MIYABI" company that occupies a corner of a giant apartment complex "Garden Hills". He has a grudge over his female boss Kanzaki. He hacks "Garden Hills" security system to find Kanzaki daughters and have his revenge.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在占据巨型公寓“Garden Hills”一角的“MIYABI”公司担任技术员。他对女上司神崎怀有怨恨。他侵入了“花园山”的安全系统，寻找神崎的女儿并报仇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
